target.title: fix(browser): preserve Deep Research selection through submit
target.body:
## Summary

- Move ChatGPT Deep Research activation into the final submit path after composer reset/attachment upload, so the tool selection is not cleared before prompt submission.
- Support the current ChatGPT tools-menu DOM shape, including `.__menu-item` rows and the `Get a detailed report` label text.
- Use trusted CDP mouse clicks for the Deep Research row fallback and send button so React/ChatGPT handlers receive real pointer events.

## Verification

- `pnpm vitest run tests/browser/deepResearch.test.ts tests/browser/promptComposer.test.ts tests/browser/index.test.ts tests/cli/browserConfig.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check CHANGELOG.md src/browser/actions/deepResearch.ts src/browser/actions/promptComposer.ts src/browser/index.ts tests/browser/deepResearch.test.ts tests/browser/promptComposer.test.ts`
- `pnpm run build && pnpm run lint`

## Manual note

Live smoke testing found that `researchMode="deep"`, a visible Deep Research pill before submit, or a normal Pro response is not enough evidence. A true ChatGPT Deep Research run should show the submitted user message with the `Deep research` tool marker and the research-plan UI (`Edit`, `Cancel`, `Start` countdown/task list). A human-validated run reached that UI after this fix. Some live retries hit ChatGPT-side `Too many requests` / `Something went wrong` responses and were not counted as successful Deep Research runs.
